cases.title: Default invariant pollution
cases.mechanism: A generic cash invariant was installed by default even when the fiction had no such resource model.
cases.lesson: Default invariant registries must be neutral; story-specific laws require explicit project ownership.

cases.title: Research freshness split-brain
cases.mechanism: Two tools computed freshness using different logic.
cases.lesson: Shared semantics belong in one implementation and multiple consumers must call it.

cases.title: Scene issue ownership lost in formatted strings
cases.mechanism: Scene-scoped diagnostics were filtered by searching a rendered error string rather than structured scene ownership.
cases.lesson: Machine ownership must stay structured until presentation.

cases.title: Checkpoint path alias duplication
cases.mechanism: Relative and absolute aliases of the same pass artifact bypassed deduplication.
cases.lesson: Canonicalize durable path identity before comparing pass references.

cases.title: Fresh init immediately unverifiable
cases.mechanism: The official init command created a manifest but omitted the minimal Story State required by its own verifier.
cases.lesson: Every public constructor must produce an object that passes its public verifier immediately.

cases.title: Profile upgrade changed labels without guarantees
cases.mechanism: A governance profile could be raised without checking that the required artifacts actually existed.
cases.lesson: Governance upgrades are transactional guarantee changes, not enum edits.

cases.title: Empty directory masqueraded as enabled protection
cases.mechanism: Legacy migration inferred a subsystem from an empty placeholder directory.
cases.lesson: Capability detection requires meaningful durable evidence, not directory existence.

cases.title: Fixture Runtime history lagged current state
cases.mechanism: A regression fixture claimed a current chapter far beyond what its committed Runtime history could replay.
cases.lesson: A Runtime fixture must replay to the state it claims to represent.

cases.title: Hard-coded orchestration capability
cases.mechanism: A template claimed a soft-serial profile and capabilities before any environment probe.
cases.lesson: Capability templates start from unknown/denied and observed evidence upgrades them.

cases.title: Project profile default split
cases.mechanism: The manifest template defaulted to Persistent while the init command and design contract defaulted to Lean.
cases.lesson: One default must have one source of truth.

cases.title: Commit-order contract split
cases.mechanism: High-level lifecycle documentation disagreed with Runtime about whether events or projections commit first.
cases.lesson: Write-side committed history precedes regenerable projections.

cases.title: Semantic law ID collision
cases.mechanism: One law ID acquired multiple meanings as the Kernel evolved.
cases.lesson: Stable semantic law identifiers are part of the compatibility surface.

cases.title: Declared branch head drifts from committed history
cases.mechanism: Project Manifest points at an event other than the active committed branch head.
cases.lesson: Semantic head identity must be cross-checked against replayable history.

cases.title: Project and Runtime identity split
cases.mechanism: Runtime Manifest identifies a different project than Project Manifest.
cases.lesson: Stable semantic identity must survive across representation layers.

cases.title: Prose-only revision smuggles canon delta
cases.mechanism: A report classifies a change as prose-only while carrying a candidate durable state delta.
cases.lesson: Minimal semantic disturbance requires label/approval/delta agreement.

cases.title: Branch-local context leaks into unrelated branch
cases.mechanism: A main-branch Writer artifact derives from a source that exists only on a sibling/sandbox branch.
cases.lesson: Branch lineage constrains context provenance.

cases.title: Open authorial unknown silently resolved
cases.mechanism: An item remains marked open while a selected answer has already been populated.
cases.lesson: Authorial possibility space must not collapse through incidental serialization.

cases.title: Approved prose evidence becomes stale after edit
cases.mechanism: Chapter prose changes after reconciliation approval while old hashes/evidence remain trusted.
cases.lesson: Evidence approval is content-addressed and becomes stale when source bytes change.

cases.title: Declassification releases an unrelated secret
cases.mechanism: An artifact claims role declassification for a secret ID it does not carry through provenance.
cases.lesson: Declassification can reduce visibility restrictions only for taint actually carried by that artifact.

cases.title: Duplicate Runtime sequence
cases.mechanism: Two committed events on one branch claim the same sequence number.
cases.lesson: Committed branch order must remain mechanically valid before replay.

cases.title: Branch forks from missing event
cases.mechanism: A child branch names a fork event absent from the parent effective history.
cases.lesson: Counterfactual lineage requires a real shared prefix.

cases.title: Enabled subsystem loses its canonical artifact
cases.mechanism: Context compilation remains enabled while its canonical Context Index pointer disappears.
cases.lesson: Declared guarantees and canonical artifacts must remain bidirectionally consistent.

cases.title: Working hypothesis launders into authoritative constraint
cases.mechanism: A viable working hypothesis is serialized again as an active compatibility constraint with a non-authoritative basis, silently shrinking authorial openness.
cases.lesson: Planning stance may guide conditional exploration but cannot narrow the authorial commitment envelope without an authoritative A-level basis.

cases.title: Excluded position remains active working hypothesis
cases.mechanism: An authoritatively excluded position still carries working_hypothesis planning stance, allowing downstream planning to depend on a possibility the commitment envelope has removed.
cases.lesson: Position viability and planning stance are orthogonal, but a working hypothesis must remain viable; exclusion invalidates that stance and its conditional dependents.

cases.title: Excluded hypothesis still supports active conditional planning
cases.mechanism: An authoritatively excluded OpenIssue position remains the source of an active conditional-on-hypothesis dependency edge into downstream planning.
cases.lesson: Conditional provenance must participate in dependency invalidation; exclusion does not merely change a label while dependent planning stays active.

cases.title: Quiet scene forcibly given a plot delta
cases.mechanism: A scene authorized for ordinary inhabitation, recurrence, or perceptual completion is repaired by inventing a plot/relationship delta solely to justify page time.
cases.lesson: Scene legitimacy follows scoped Project Poetics; durable change is one contribution mode, not the universal ontology of scene.

cases.title: Theme coerced into polyphonic debate
cases.mechanism: A perceptual, ritual, symbolic, or obsession-centered theme is forced into competing positions because polyphony was treated as the universal owner of theme.
cases.lesson: Thematic polyphony is a selectable capability, not a requirement for all themes.

cases.title: Authorized formal heterogeneity normalized as voice drift
cases.mechanism: A chapter-scoped formal override is standardized back toward the project baseline because surface invariance was mistaken for consistency.
cases.lesson: Consistency is not invariance; diagnostics must distinguish authorized scoped variation from accidental drift.

cases.title: First-person self-report promoted to psychological canon
cases.mechanism: The narrator's sincere self-explanation is stored or treated as objective psychological truth, collapsing self-model, narrator statement, world fact, and reader inference.
cases.lesson: First-person access is not psychological truth; preserve epistemic layer distinctions.

cases.title: Inactive capability becomes readiness bureaucracy
cases.mechanism: A project is blocked because a Hidden Network, detailed Timeline, Reader Model, or other capability artifact is absent despite never being activated by causal risk or Project Poetics.
cases.lesson: Base Readiness plus activated artifacts replaces the fixed universal planning bundle.

cases.title: Declared active optional artifact missing
cases.mechanism: An optional artifact is explicitly declared active in the Project Manifest but its referenced file does not exist.
cases.lesson: Optional means conditional, not unverified: inactive artifacts create no debt, but explicitly active obligations must be present and valid.

cases.title: Production false readiness and self-reported maturity
cases.mechanism: Claimed readiness counted files and declarations without structured chapter/Cast/Scene evidence.
cases.lesson: Evidence-backed first-volume/current-cone safety plus live formal permission.

cases.title: Approval drift and stale live handoff
cases.mechanism: Old approval or identical Markdown concealed changed readiness or compilation metadata.
cases.lesson: Freeze/present/new approval and compare complete live pack manifests.

cases.title: Transitive provenance and injected taint laundering
cases.mechanism: Missing indirect ancestors, unknown secret labels or injected scoped-poetics aliases could bypass provenance/taint closure.
cases.lesson: Unique nodes, transitive incomplete-parent closure, registered taints and preserved injected derivation.

cases.title: Windows neutral-template byte drift
cases.mechanism: Text-mode neutral Project Poetics bootstrap changed template bytes on Windows.
cases.lesson: Copy exact template bytes and hash the same bytes.
